period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)' (p.7) and its Off-Balance-Sheet/NAV continuation (p.8) and 'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (p.9) — distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements for BRAC Bank Limited and its subsidiaries printed earlier in the same filing (p.2-4). Matches the basis of this bank's own 2021-2025 Q4/annual series (solo). Figures read visually from 150dpi page renders (image-based PDF, no text layer; only the first 22 of the filing's approx. 51 pages were rendered — the extra length versus other Q1 filings appears to be additional notes/annexures beyond page 22, not a second statement set; the core BS/P&L were found near the front as expected, so nothing needed was missed). For Q1 the discrete quarter and cumulative-from-Jan-1 periods are identical, so income-statement items use plain (non-cumulative) names. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: asset components sum to 580,292,772,702 = reported Total property and assets; liabilities+equity (520,411,109,726 + 59,881,662,976) = 580,292,772,702, an exact match. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII+Investment income+Commission+Other operating income=Total operating income; less opex=profit before provisions; less provision=PBT; less tax=PAT). Cross-check: comparative (31 Dec 2022) column here shows Total shareholders' equity 58,390,554,773 (≈58,391m) and Total assets 563,238,978,302 (≈563,239m), both very slightly below this bank's own 2022_Q4.json (58,418m equity; 563,271m assets; gap ~0.05% and ~0.006% respectively, traced mainly to a ~32m difference in 'Other assets'). 2022_Q4.json was sourced from the FY2025 Annual Report's retrospective Five-Year Summary table, which post-dates this interim filing (published May 2023) by two years, so per project convention ('prefer the contemporaneous/originally-reported figure') this filing's own comparative column is arguably the better-dated source for 31-Dec-2022; flagging the small discrepancy here for a future reconciliation pass rather than editing 2022_Q4.json directly (out of scope for this task — only the four assigned quarters were touched). No CAR/NPL/ROA/ROE ratio table was found within the rendered page range. 'Profit/(loss) before provisions' is the only such subtotal line in the solo P&L (no separate 'Operating profit' line above it), so per this bank's established convention for solo Q1 statements (see 2011_Q1.json, 2015_Q1.json, 2016_Q1.json, 2017_Q1.json) it is recorded here as plain operating_profit. The equity sub-reserves 'Dividend equalization fund', 'Revaluation reserve on govt. securities', 'Fair value gain/(loss) on equity investment' and 'Foreign currency translation reserve' were visible on the balance sheet but, per this bank's established convention, are not recorded as separate line items (only the four standard components + total are captured).
